authority: New audit contract, not a claim that upstream implements these requirements.

coordinate_map.g1: gY in ordinary Standard Model hypercharge normalization

coordinate_map_scope: This records the repository DEP branch, not a universal map to the separately implemented Litim branch. A single action convention must replace the conflicting branch labels.

NP_scalar_mass_matching.status: factor-of-two mismatch; changing it alone does not reconcile backgrounds, Higgs multiplicity, or nonminimal signs

field_normalization.regular_chart: Z_i > 0, with canonically normalized fields sqrt(Z_i)*phi_i

required_projection_work.required: Choose regular higher-curvature coordinates and one gravity/matter Hessian; include mixing. Existing inverse coordinates are singular at the selected point; standalone CPR beta_aC2 is nonzero.
Declare scalar invariant normalization, integration-by-parts/EOM basis and momentum subtraction projector; project the p^2 part of appropriate four-scalar vertices with all selected traces.

Declare whether F denotes U(1), SU(2), SU(3), or a fixed combination. A general scalar-bilinear gauge-strength set has a separate coefficient for each scalar invariant and each gauge factor; project transverse two-gauge/two-scalar vertices.

common_flow_acceptance_criteria: One explicitly defined field content, action, gauge fixing, ghost normalization and regulator prescription, or a derived matching map between schemes.
All retained beta projections finite in a regular field-normalization chart; no missing entries silently replaced by zero.
Gravity, scalar, gauge, Yukawa, nonminimal and higher-derivative mixing included to the declared truncation order, with controlled omission estimates.
Nonzero Newton fixed point satisfies beta_gN=(2+eta_N)*gN and eta_N=-2; distinguish background eta_N from fluctuation eta_h.
Residual, basis/field-normalization checks, derivative-step convergence, regulator sensitivity and truncation enlargement assessed before claiming physical critical exponents.
Nonlinear analysis resolves zero linear exponents before an exact-marginality or UV-critical-surface dimension claim.
